etymology.historical_story: Nakkan shows how conversational Malay compresses familiar expressions without losing their objects. DBP’s language advisory explicitly connects it with hendakkan or hendak akan and accepts its joined spelling in informal dialogue. This is a documented register distinction rather than a separate borrowing story. See [DBP’s explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=satu+kan); formal prose normally restores a fuller expression suited to the context.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nak 是“想要”，nakkan 后面接“想要的对象”：nakkan yang biru＝想要蓝色那个。别把它拆成“想要，对吧？”

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，整词作为独立词素记忆；字母 o 读单元音 /o/，词尾 s 属于词根，不是复数标记。

word_family.gloss: 有通知的；事先发出通知的
多份通知；以全词重叠表示复数

senses.zh_definition: 通知；公告；就某事或即将发生的事项作出的告知，常以书面形式发布。
senses.en_definition: A notice or announcement communicating information about a matter or forthcoming event.
senses.ms_definition: Pengumuman tentang sesuatu yang akan berlaku, pemberitahuan, kenyataan.
senses.nuances: 常指张贴、寄送或电子发布的通知。英语 notice 表示“注意到”时，不能直接译为马来语动词 notis，应按语境用 menyedari 或注意义的其他表达。[DBP：notis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=notis)

senses.zh_definition: 预先通知；就终止工作、合同或其他安排的意向提前作出的告知。
senses.en_definition: Advance notification of an intention to end employment, a contract, or another arrangement.
senses.ms_definition: Pemberitahuan awal tentang niat untuk menamatkan sesuatu urusan, kontrak, kerja, dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 可用于雇员辞职、雇主终止雇佣或合同终止等不同方向；单独的 notis 不说明是谁提出终止。tempoh notis 指通知期，具体期限由相应安排决定。[DBP：notis，义项二](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=notis)

dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak pengurusan telah mengeluarkan notis mengenai penutupan sementara pejabat untuk kerja penyelenggaraan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 管理层已发出通知，说明办公室将因维修工作暂时关闭。
dual_scenarios.en: Management has issued a notice announcing the temporary closure of the office for maintenance.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca notis kat lif tu?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Awak sudah membaca notis yang ditampal di lif itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看过电梯里贴的那张通知了吗？

spoken_features: kau 是熟人之间使用的非正式第二人称。
dah 对应 sudah。
kat 对应地点介词 di，tu 对应 itu。

messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca notis kat lif tu? Esok air kena potong.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身中性，但正式通知宜清楚写明事项、日期及所需行动；涉及辞职或合同终止时，措辞宜客观、尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 日常聊天可以转述通知内容；正式场合应区分一般公告、辞职通知和终止通知。bernotis 表示事先通知，见于官方行政用语。[马来西亚社团注册局：bernotis](https://www.ros.gov.my/portal-main/article?id=bahagian-penguatkuasaan)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身中性，但正式通知宜清楚写明事项、日期及所需行动；涉及辞职或合同终止时，措辞宜客观、尊重。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 日常聊天可以转述通知内容；正式场合应区分一般公告、辞职通知和终止通知。bernotis 表示事先通知，见于官方行政用语。[马来西亚社团注册局：bernotis](https://www.ros.gov.my/portal-main/article?id=bahagian-penguatkuasaan)

etymology.historical_story: Notis is an English loanword, identified as such by DBP. Its Malay spelling reflects an adapted form of notice. In current usage, it covers both announcements and advance notification that an arrangement will end. The familiar papan notis places the word in everyday school, office, and residential life. [DBP: notis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=notis)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: no-tis 联想英语 notice：看到公告是 notis；提前告知结束安排也是 notis。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语借词，现代马来语中作为完整词根记忆；词末 k 通常读作声门塞音 [ʔ]。没有为补足词族而生造派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 处于生命垂危、濒临死亡的状态。
senses.en_definition: At the point of death; in a dying condition.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam keadaan hampir meninggal dunia.
senses.nuances: 语义强于一般的 sakit teruk（病得很重），明确涉及濒死状态；不等于已经死亡。中文通常译为“弥留”或“生命垂危”。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻物品严重损坏、几乎无法继续使用，或机构、事业等濒临崩溃。
senses.en_definition: In extremely poor condition, nearly unusable or close to collapse.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam keadaan sangat teruk sehingga hampir tidak dapat digunakan atau tidak dapat bertahan lagi.
senses.nuances: 用于设备时常带夸张或幽默色彩；用于企业、经济等则表示严重衰败，语气明显重于 lemah（疲弱）。

collocations.en: the engine is on its last legs
an economy on the brink of collapse

dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak hospital membenarkan ahli keluarga menemani pesakit yang sedang nazak itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 院方允许家属陪伴那位正处于弥留状态的病人。
dual_scenarios.en: The hospital allowed family members to stay with the dying patient.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Komputer riba saya sudah nazak; membuka fail pun mengambil masa yang lama.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我这台笔记本快不行了，开个文件都慢。
dual_scenarios.en: My laptop's on its last legs. Even opening a file takes ages.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式
lah 增添感叹和抱怨语气
aku 用于熟人之间
nazak 比喻设备接近报废

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Laptop aku dah nazak lah, buka fail pun lambat.
messages.ms_standard: Komputer riba saya sudah nazak; membuka fail pun mengambil masa yang lama.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈及病人时语气沉重，应体谅家属感受；面向家属可视情况采用 keadaan sangat tenat（情况极危重）等较委婉的表达。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 朋友之间可以用来形容旧设备；面对正在经历重病或丧亲的人，应避免拿 nazak 开玩笑，也不要随意用它断言他人的病情。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈及病人时语气沉重，应体谅家属感受；面向家属可视情况采用 keadaan sangat tenat（情况极危重）等较委婉的表达。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 朋友之间可以用来形容旧设备；面对正在经历重病或丧亲的人，应避免拿 nazak 开玩笑，也不要随意用它断言他人的病情。

etymology.historical_story: Nazak is an Arabic borrowing associated with the throes of death. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic letters نزع, even though ordinary Malay pronunciation adapts the ending. Malay also extends the word metaphorically: an old engine or failing business can be nazak, transferring the image of a dying person to something barely functioning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把词末突然收住的 [ʔ] 想成机器运转到最后一下便停住：nazak＝生命或功能快到尽头；这只是记忆联想。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。naib pengerusi 等属于分写的复合称谓；词尾 /b/ 在部分马来西亚口音中实现为不送气、不释放的 [p̚]。

senses.zh_definition: 代表他人行使职务或代替他人办事的人；代理人。
senses.en_definition: A representative or substitute acting on another person's behalf.
senses.ms_definition: Pengganti; wakil.
senses.nuances: 强调代行职责，常见于传统行政和宗教称谓；不一定表示固定的第二级职位。词义依据：[DBP：naib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=261624&keyword=naib)。

senses.zh_definition: 职务称谓中的“副”；担任辅助或次一级领导职务的人。
senses.en_definition: A deputy or vice officeholder, used in compound titles.
senses.ms_definition: Penolong kepada; timbalan.
senses.nuances: 须依机构正式称谓使用。naib canselor 通常指大学的最高行政负责人，不能仅凭 naib 将其职位误解为普通副校长。[DBP：naib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=261624&keyword=naib)。

senses.zh_definition: 在固定搭配 naib johan 中表示比赛的第二名，即亚军。
senses.en_definition: Runner-up, specifically in the fixed expression naib johan.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam rangkai kata naib johan: pemenang kedua dalam pertandingan.
senses.nuances: “亚军”义属于整个搭配 naib johan；不能把单独的 naib 普遍理解为“第二名”。[DBP：naib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=261624&keyword=naib)。

senses.zh_definition: 【印度尼西亚用语】伊斯兰法官或主持相关宗教事务的卡迪。
senses.en_definition: In Indonesian usage, a kadi or Islamic judicial official.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam penggunaan Indonesia: kadi.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标注 Id，属于地域用法，不宜当作现代马来西亚通用称谓。下列为说明性短语，不表示已验证其使用频率。[DBP：naib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=261624&keyword=naib)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Mesyuarat itu akan dipengerusikan oleh naib pengerusi persatuan kerana pengerusi sedang menghadiri urusan rasmi di luar negeri.
dual_scenarios.zh: 由于主席正在国外处理公务，本次会议将由协会副主席主持。
dual_scenarios.en: The meeting will be chaired by the association's vice-chairperson because the chairperson is abroad on official business.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pasukan kita dapat naib johan je, tapi semua dah main habis baik.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pasukan kita hanya mendapat tempat sebagai naib johan, tetapi semua pemain sudah bermain sebaik mungkin.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我们队只拿到亚军，不过大家都已经尽全力了。
dual_scenarios.en: We only finished runners-up, but everyone gave it their best.
spoken_features: je 相当于 sahaja，表示“只”
dah 相当于 sudah
main habis baik 是表示“尽全力比赛”的口语说法
但书面语中宜补出 pemain 等明确主语

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Pasukan kau menang ke tadi?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah pasukan kamu menang tadi?
messages.zh: 你们队刚才赢了吗？
messages.en: Did your team win earlier?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dapat naib johan je, tapi semua dah main habis baik.
messages.ms_standard: Pasukan kami hanya mendapat tempat sebagai naib johan, tetapi semua pemain sudah bermain sebaik mungkin.
messages.zh: 只拿到亚军，不过大家都尽全力了。
messages.en: We finished runners-up, but everyone gave it their best.

etymology.historical_story: Naib comes from Arabic nāʾib, a representative or deputy. Its older association with acting for another person remains visible in Malay expressions such as naib raja and naib kadi. Modern organisational titles retain the same core idea, while naib johan identifies the competitor immediately below the champion. The borrowed word functions as a complete Malay base. [Arabic dictionary: nāʾib](https://kutub.nur.nu/Arabic-Language/Hans-Wehr.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naib 想成站在正职旁边、能够代行职责的人；接上 johan“冠军”，就是紧随冠军的亚军。

etymology.historical_story: Nilai connects monetary appraisal with judgments of quality and social worth. In its literary illustration, Kamus Dewan describes the Malay work Tuhfatul-Nafis as having high nilai, showing that worth need not mean a price. Nilainya adds a backward reference: the worth belongs to something already under discussion, whether an asset, a text, or an idea. [DBP：nilai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=102560&keyword=nilai)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nilai＝价值，-nya＝它的：nilainya 就是它值多少，也可以是它有什么意义。

etymology.historical_story: Neville entered English naming through a surname associated with Norman place names such as Neuville and Néville. The familiar interpretation is 'new town' or 'new settlement'. The surname later also became a given name. This history explains its naming background; it does not make Neville a Malay word meaning a newly built town. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/neville)

etymology.historical_story: English nothing descends through Middle English from Old English nāthing, combining a negative element with thing. Its history makes the meaning unusually visible: literally, no thing. For a Malay learner, this offers a useful contrast. English packages the idea into one word, while Malay commonly expresses it with tiada apa-apa or tidak ada apa-apa. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=nothing)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 no + thing，就想到“一样东西也没有”；马来语接成 tiada apa-apa。

etymology.historical_story: Nandu belongs to an international group of bird names associated with South American Indigenous languages. A Smithsonian field account records ñandu as a Guaraní name used for the rhea and also for a spider. This documents the regional name, but does not establish the precise route by which nandu entered Malay. See the [Smithsonian account](https://repository.si.edu/bitstream/handle/10088/10240/1/USNMB_1331926_unit.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: English name continues Old English nama or noma and has Germanic relatives such as German Name and Dutch naam. etymology.historical_story: Nova comes from Latin meaning new. The name preserves an earlier interpretation of the sky: when a previously inconspicuous star suddenly brightened, observers could mistake it for a newly appearing star. Modern astronomy explains classical novae through eruptions involving white dwarfs, so the historical name describes the surprise of discovery rather than the birth of a star. [NASA](https://science.nasa.gov/exoplanets/stars/).

etymology.historical_story: Nikmat comes from Arabic niʿmah, meaning a blessing or favour. Its religious sense remains visible in Malay expressions of gratitude to Allah. Malay also uses the word for deliciousness and the pleasures of ordinary life. Classical literature preserves another sense: delicacies served at a feast. These meanings connect a received blessing with something enjoyed through the senses. [Sources: Arabic origin](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/nikmat), [DBP senses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=nikmat).

etymology.historical_story: Nahas comes from Arabic naḥs, meaning ill luck. Malay preserves the connection with misfortune while also using the word for concrete accidents. This makes the vocabulary memorable: an unlucky day and a road accident share one headword, although describing an accident does not itself imply belief in omens. Source: [NUSA linguistic study](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v19-p1-38.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Neal belongs to a group of name forms associated with Irish Niall. Patrick Woulfe's 1923 reference lists Neal alongside Neale and Neil under Niall, showing that these spellings belong to an established naming tradition. This connection concerns the name's history; it does not identify a particular bearer or supply an ordinary Malay lexical meaning. [Irish Names and Surnames](https://libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/men/niall-niall.php)

etymology.historical_story: Nyamuk belongs to the vocabulary of everyday encounters with insects. Malay extends that familiar experience into figurative language: the dictionary records nyamuk mati gatal tak lepas, describing resentment that remains even after a wrongdoer has been punished. The lingering itch supplies the image. This is a cultural association, rather than a claim about the word's earliest origin.

etymology.historical_story: Nipis belongs to an inherited Austronesian word family rather than a recent European borrowing. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary connects Malay nipis with reconstructed *Nipis, referring to thinness of materials, and records relatives across widely separated languages. A simple description of paper or fruit skin therefore preserves evidence of a much older shared vocabulary. [ACD](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/30856)

etymology.historical_story: Ne represents neon, whose name comes from Greek neos, meaning new. William Ramsay and Morris Travers discovered the element in 1898 while investigating liquefied air. Its distinctive spectral lines helped identify it. The symbol belongs to international chemical notation, so its capitalization remains the same in Malay scientific writing. [PubChem](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/element/10)

etymology.historical_story: Negara belongs to Malay’s Sanskrit-derived vocabulary: nagara meant a town or city, while the Malay word developed the broader meaning of a state or country. Adding -nya connects that country to someone already mentioned. A word once associated with an urban centre thus serves modern conversations about citizenship, national representation and returning home. See [DBP’s discussion of semantic change](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/05/eDigital_Semantik-zd9b39.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 negara＝国家，再把尾巴 -nya 看成“他／她的”：negara + nya＝他／她的国家。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入的 syllables 值“sso sst”不是有效音节划分，仅按要求保留；news 实为单音节。词尾 s 发 /z/，不是马来语词缀。英式读音为 /njuːz/，美式常为 /nuːz/。[Cambridge 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/pronunciation/english/news)

senses.zh_definition: 新闻；消息；关于近期事件或此前未知情况的信息。
senses.en_definition: Information about recent events or previously unknown developments.
senses.ms_definition: Berita atau khabar tentang kejadian terkini atau perkara yang belum diketahui.
senses.nuances: 英语词，在马来语对话中可作为语码转换使用；规范马来语通常用 berita 或 khabar。英语中为不可数名词，通常搭配单数谓语。本项马来文释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文；official 沿用指定记录标签，不表示已获马来语规范词资格。以下为非正式夹语组合，不作语料频率排名。[Cambridge 用法](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/news)

senses.zh_definition: 电视、广播或网络播出的新闻节目。
senses.en_definition: A programme presenting reports of current events.
senses.ms_definition: Rancangan yang menyiarkan laporan tentang peristiwa semasa.
senses.nuances: 英语 the news 可指新闻节目；马来语夹语中可省略英语冠词。正式表达宜用 siaran berita 或 rancangan berita。[Cambridge 用法](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/news)

etymology.historical_story: English news is recorded from the fifteenth century, long before television or online feeds. Its modern uses cover both fresh information and broadcast reports. In a Malay conversation, retaining news introduces an English element; a Malay-language editor normally chooses berita. The final s does not make it an ordinary countable plural. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/news)

etymology.historical_story: Niaga belongs to the vocabulary of commerce associated with historical contact between South and Southeast Asia. Its Sanskrit connections are discussed alongside older merchant terms, although the exact route should not be reduced to a simple modern affix formula. Today, Malay speakers use niaga as a base for berniaga, peniaga and perniagaan. [Historical discussion](https://cdn.angkordatabase.asia/libs/docs/maritime-trade-and-state-development.pdf), [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=351284&keyword=niaga)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niaga 联想成“你呀，做买卖”：berniaga 是做生意，peniaga 是做生意的人，perniagaan 是生意本身。此为记忆联想，并非词源拆解。

etymology.historical_story: Nelson has several surname histories. English examples can derive from older personal names such as Nell or Nele, while some American families acquired the spelling through adaptation of Scandinavian surnames. The name also functions as a given name. These different routes caution against assigning every bearer one ancestry or treating the spelling as a Malay compound. [Source](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/nelson)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nelson 的英语读音记成“NEL—sən”，首音节较重；看到它先想到人物名牌，不把 -son 当作马来语词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: 在现代马来语中按完整借词处理；结尾 -i 不应拆作马来语动词后缀。nur 是相关的阿拉伯语来源借词。

word_family.gloss: 良心；内心深处纯正的感受

senses.zh_definition: 有光的；明亮的；在宗教或文学表达中，指内心受到神圣光明照耀的。
senses.en_definition: Luminous or radiant, especially spiritually illuminated.
senses.ms_definition: Bercahaya; terang, khususnya dalam pengertian kerohanian.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 所列的基本形容词义，具有宗教或文学色彩，不是日常描述灯光亮度的常用词。hati nurani 可指获得神圣光明指引的心。释义依据：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=nurani)。

collocations.zh: 受到神圣光明指引的心

senses.zh_definition: 良心；内心深处纯正、能辨别是非的道德感。
senses.en_definition: Conscience; one's deepest moral awareness or inner sense of right and wrong.
senses.ms_definition: Perasaan hati yang murni dan sedalam-dalamnya, khususnya yang berkaitan dengan pertimbangan baik dan buruk.
senses.nuances: 常见于 hati nurani、suara nurani 等表达；单用 nurani 表示良心具有较强的书面或文学色彩。该义与内心光明的意象相连，不等同于意识或知觉意义的 kesedaran。hati nurani 的释义见：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=nurani)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies nurani as an Arabic borrowing and gives its basic meaning as luminous or bright. In hati nurani, physical light becomes an image of divine guidance and the heart's deepest purity. This connection helps explain the familiar moral reading of the expression: conscience is imagined as an inner light that guides a person's judgment. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=nurani)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nur 联想到“光”：心里有一盏辨别是非的灯，就是 hati nurani——良心。

etymology.historical_story: Nyawamu combines nyawa with the shortened second-person pronoun -mu. Malay writes this pronoun together with the preceding noun. Culturally, nyawa reaches beyond biological survival: DBP also records its figurative use for a dearly loved person. This explains why the word can carry both the urgency of a safety warning and the tenderness of poetry. [DBP：代词拼写](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=singkat), [DBP：nyawa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=nyawa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住mu＝“你的”：nyawa是生命，nyawamu就是“你的命”；把mu换成ku，nyawaku就变成“我的命”。

etymology.historical_story: Nagori carries a local sense of place and community. Cultural documentation from Kuantan uses it within customary institutions, while Simalungun government usage gives it a specific village-administration meaning. These settings reveal how a regional word can belong both to inherited community life and to present-day public administration. The packet does not establish its precise historical borrowing route. [Kuantan cultural documentation](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/29830/1/KEBUDAYAAN%20PERBATASAN%20MELAYU%20KUANTAN%20SINGINGI.pdf) [Simalungun government](https://diskominfo.simalungunkab.go.id/berita/tingkatkan-kualitas-layanan-publik-pemkab-simalungun-luncurkan-aplikasi-pelayanan-nagori-digital)

etymology.historical_story: Narkoba belongs to Indonesia's modern vocabulary of public education and drug prevention. Its familiar expansion links narkotika with obat berbahaya, while Indonesia's National Narcotics Board also explains its scope as narcotics, psychotropics, and other addictive substances. These overlapping explanations reflect institutional usage. Malaysian learners encounter the word particularly through Indonesian news, whereas dadah is the usual Malaysian term.

etymology.historical_story: Nicole is a French feminine form of Nicolas, ultimately connected with Greek Nikolaos and the elements for victory and people. That historical association explains the name's ancestry, not its everyday meaning in Malay. In a Malaysian sentence, Nicole identifies a person; it does not translate as a description of victory or character. [Name history](https://www.ancestry.com/first-name-meaning/nicole?geo-lang=fr)

senses.zh_definition: 给予劝告、提醒或指导；把某事作为建议提出。
senses.en_definition: To give advice or guidance; to recommend something as a course of action.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan sesuatu sebagai nasihat atau sebagai tunjuk ajar.
senses.nuances: nasihatkan 常用于请求或指示别人进行劝告。完整形式 menasihatkan 的词典释义侧重所给予的建议；menasihati 则明确侧重接受建议的人，但实际用法存在重叠。不能把 nasihatkan 一概判为不规范，因为祈使句可以省略 meN-。[DBP：menasihatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=menasihatkan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 主管向培训负责人作出指示
dual_scenarios.ms: Nasihatkan semua peserta supaya mematuhi peraturan keselamatan sepanjang program ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请劝导所有参与者在整个活动期间遵守安全规定。
dual_scenarios.en: Advise all participants to observe the safety rules throughout the programme.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 兄妹商量怎样劝弟弟
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tolong nasihatkan adik tu baik-baik, jangan terus marah dia lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tolong nasihatkan adik itu dengan baik dan jangan terus memarahinya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 好好劝劝弟弟啦，别一上来就骂他。
dual_scenarios.en: Please have a gentle word with him. Don't just start scolding him.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式
baik-baik 在此表示温和、妥当地
lah 为句末语气词；此处用于强调劝说，语气仍取决于说话方式

messages.speaker: Farah (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Tolong nasihatkan adik tu. Dia dah cakap nak berhenti sekolah.
messages.ms_standard: Tolong nasihatkan adik itu. Dia sudah mengatakan bahawa dia mahu berhenti sekolah.
messages.zh: 你劝劝弟弟吧。他已经说想退学了。
messages.en: Please talk to our little brother. He's said he wants to quit school.

messages.ms_standard: Nanti aku akan menasihatinya dengan baik. Aku mahu mendengar masalahnya terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 我等会儿好好劝他。我想先听听他遇到了什么问题。
messages.en: I'll have a gentle word with him later. I want to hear what's bothering him first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接要求成年人接受劝告，容易显得居高临下。请求别人劝导某人时可加 tolong；亲自提出建议时，可用 Boleh saya beri sedikit pandangan? 来缓和语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合家庭、教育和辅导语境。涉及对方的私事或过错时，宜私下温和沟通，避免当众训话；与长辈或上司交谈时尤其需要顾及称谓和语气。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接要求成年人接受劝告，容易显得居高临下。请求别人劝导某人时可加 tolong；亲自提出建议时，可用 Boleh saya beri sedikit pandangan? 来缓和语气。

etymology.historical_story: Nasihat comes from Arabic naṣīḥa, meaning advice or counsel. Malay incorporated the borrowed noun into its own word-building system, producing menasihati, menasihatkan and penasihat. Nasihatkan combines that inherited borrowing with the Malay suffix -kan. Its structure illustrates how a word associated with ethical guidance can become part of ordinary requests between family members and friends. [词源](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/nasihat)。[DBP：词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=nasihat)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 nasihat＝忠告，再接 -kan：把忠告说给别人听。na-si-hat-kan，四拍记住“给出劝告”。

morphology.formula: anakanda → nanda（词汇化缩略，无生产性词缀）
morphology.pattern_note: 按数据包将 nanda 作为独立词目保存；DBP 说明它是 anakanda 的缩略形式。这里的缩略不属于前缀或后缀添加，不应把 na- 或 -nda 生造为本词的生产性词缀。

word_family.gloss: 完整形式：孩子；用于文雅或王室语体
相关基础词：孩子；并非由 nanda 派生

senses.zh_definition: anakanda 的简称：对孩子的文雅、亲切称呼，常见于书信或文学语境；也可依书信关系用于孩子自称。
senses.en_definition: A shortened form of anakanda: a refined or affectionate term for a child, especially in correspondence, also usable as a child's self-reference.
senses.ms_definition: Kependekan bagi anakanda, iaitu anak dalam bahasa halus atau bahasa diraja, terutama dalam surat-menyurat.
senses.nuances: DBP 明确释为 kep anakanda，见 [DBP：nanda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=nanda)。其书信及文雅语体依据 [DBP：anakanda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=36924&keyword=anakanda)。这是称谓性名词，也可承担人称指代功能。下列为合乎该语体的搭配示例，不主张它们在现代口语中高频。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam surat yang dipamerkan itu, penulis menggunakan sapaan nanda yang dikasihi untuk menyapa anaknya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在展出的那封信中，写信人用“亲爱的孩子”这一称呼来称呼自己的孩子。
dual_scenarios.en: In the letter on display, the writer addresses their child as 'dear child', using the expression nanda yang dikasihi.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流（刻意采用文雅亲昵称呼）
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nanda dah makan ke? Bonda baru masak ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah nanda sudah makan? Bonda baru sahaja selesai memasak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 孩子，吃过了吗？妈妈刚做好饭呢。
dual_scenarios.en: Have you eaten, dear? Mum has just finished cooking.
spoken_features: nanda 与 bonda 在这里是家人刻意采用的文雅亲昵称呼，并非普通聊天的默认称谓。
dah 是 sudah 的口语形式。
句末 ke 表示疑问。
ni 在这里增添眼前情境和随意语气。

messages.speaker: Salmah (母亲)
messages.ms_spoken: Nanda dah makan ke? Bonda baru masak ni.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah nanda sudah makan? Bonda baru sahaja selesai memasak.
messages.zh: 孩子，吃过了吗？妈妈刚做好饭呢。
messages.en: Have you eaten, dear? Mum has just finished cooking.

messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi, bonda. Nanda nak balik sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Belum lagi, bonda. Nanda hendak pulang sekarang.
messages.zh: 还没呢，妈妈。我现在就回家。
messages.en: Not yet, Mum. I'm heading home now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合亲子书信、文学表达或双方习惯的亲昵称呼。现代日常交流更常直接叫名字，或使用家中惯用的称呼。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不要把 nanda 当作称呼所有年轻人、下属或陌生人的通用敬语。涉及真实王室成员时，应依具体身份和礼仪使用完整称谓。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合亲子书信、文学表达或双方习惯的亲昵称呼。现代日常交流更常直接叫名字，或使用家中惯用的称呼。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 不要把 nanda 当作称呼所有年轻人、下属或陌生人的通用敬语。涉及真实王室成员时，应依具体身份和礼仪使用完整称谓。

etymology.historical_story: Nanda is recorded by Kamus Dewan as a shortened form of anakanda. The fuller form belongs to refined and royal language and is especially associated with correspondence. This connection gives nanda a literary, affectionate character rather than making it an ordinary replacement for anak in every sentence. Its recorded formation is shortening; a separate ancient origin is not established by the supplied evidence.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anakanda 缩短成 nanda：形式短了，家书里“亲爱的孩子”那份亲切还在。

morphology.formula: ∅ + nie → nie；对应规范形式 ini，常见口语形式 ni
morphology.pattern_note: 此处将 nie 作为不可再作词缀分析的口语书写形式处理。它通常表示 ini 缩短后的 /ni/，末尾 e 不另成音节。DBP 收录 ni 为 ini 的缩略形式；这不能据此证明 nie 是规范拼写。[DBP：ni](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ni)

word_family.gloss: 这；这个；常见口语缩略形式

senses.zh_definition: 这；这个；这些。ini 的非规范聊天拼写，用来指近处的人或事物，以及当前谈论的事情或时间。
senses.en_definition: An informal chat spelling of ini: this or these, referring to something nearby, current, or under discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi bentuk percakapan ni, iaitu singkatan bagi ini, untuk menunjukkan orang, benda, perkara atau waktu yang dekat atau sedang diperkatakan.
senses.nuances: 实际词类是指示代词 kata ganti nama tunjuk，此处归入名词类。通常置于名词之后，如 buku nie；hari nie 对应 hari ini。句末使用时也可突出当前处境，如 penat nie。它本身不表示复数，也不必然表示撒娇。输入中的 official 状态不代表 nie 获得规范拼写认可。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报：说明聊天拼写的规范替换
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam penulisan rasmi, ejaan "nie" hendaklah digantikan dengan "ini".
dual_scenarios.zh: 在正式写作中，应把拼写“nie”改为“ini”。
dual_scenarios.en: In formal writing, the spelling "nie" should be replaced with "ini".

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合熟人聊天、私人留言及模拟口语的对白。公文、履历、考试作文和正式工作邮件使用 ini；正式文本需要展示 nie 时，应作为引述或语言实例出现。

etymology.historical_story: The useful connection is with ini, the ordinary Malay demonstrative meaning this. DBP records ni as its shortened form. Nie can be understood as an informal spelling of that spoken form, rather than a separate inherited root with its own established history. In everyday messages, it brings the demonstrative into the relaxed register of conversation; formal writing retains ini.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ini 开头的 i 省掉，就听见 ni；聊天写成 nie，意思仍是“这”。

morphology.pattern_note: 依资料包作为独立口语词头处理；这不表示它与 omong 无构词联系。DBP 将其转释为 mengomong，并指向 omong；不应把 ng- 教作标准马来语中可自由套用的前缀。

word_family.gloss: 说话；由 omong 加前缀形成，与 ngomong 对应
话语；谈论的内容；由 omong 派生

senses.zh_definition: 说话、讲话；通过言语表达或谈论某事。
senses.en_definition: To speak or talk; to say something or talk about a subject.
senses.ms_definition: Mengomong, iaitu bercakap atau berkata.
senses.nuances: 属于非正式表达，在印尼语及受其影响的交流中尤为显眼。马来西亚日常表达通常更自然地使用 cakap、bercakap 或 berbual；不能把它一概译成具有正式讨论意味的 discuss。依据 [DBP：ngomong](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ngomong) 与 [DBP：omong](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=omong)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP treats ngomong as equivalent to mengomong and directs readers to omong, whose family includes words for speaking and conversation. The form is especially familiar from Indonesian informal usage. Its dictionary presence is a useful reminder that related regional speech forms can be recorded in Malay dictionaries without becoming the usual choice for formal Malaysian prose.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 开头 ng 是 /ŋ/，像英语 sing 的尾音直接开口；想象嘴巴不停 ngomong，就记住“说话、聊天”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来地理专名整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。规范正文首字母大写；所列 IPA 为按马来语音值推定的读法，并非已核实的 DBP 注音。

etymology.historical_story: Nevada comes from a Spanish adjective meaning snow-covered. Nevada's official tourism account connects the name with the Sierra Nevada mountain range. The snowy name offers a memorable contrast with the desert landscapes many visitors associate with the state. In Malay, it remains a geographical proper name rather than a word assembled from Malay roots. See [Travel Nevada](https://travelnevada.com/es/historia-y-legado/todo-sobre-nevada/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ne-va-da 三拍与“内华达”配对，再想象沙漠远处的雪山：名字源义是“覆雪的”。

headword.status_note: official 按指定格式保留为条目状态；本词是英语词，出现在马来语中属于语码转换，不表示它是规范马来语词。

etymology.historical_story: English nobody developed from the combination no body, with body understood as a person. Oxford traces it to Middle English. This history explains why its central meaning concerns people rather than physical bodies. In a Malay conversation, its appearance illustrates a switch into English; it should not be analysed as a Malay word with local prefixes. [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/nobody_1)

etymology.historical_story: Narkotik belongs to an international vocabulary ultimately associated with Greek narkōtikos, meaning numbing. Related European forms developed medical meanings connected with diminished sensation and stupor. In Malay, the word occurs both in descriptions of drugs and in institutional language. This historical connection explains the sound resemblance to English narcotic; it does not establish which language supplied the Malay word directly. [Collins Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/narcotic)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nar-ko-tik 与英语 narcotic 几乎同音：先联想“感觉麻木”，再记住它在新闻里常指“毒品”。

etymology.historical_story: Nisha is associated with Sanskrit niśā, meaning night, and occurs as a personal name in South Asian naming traditions. In Malaysia, however, Nisha may also be a nickname derived from a longer name. These possibilities must remain separate: a Sanskrit association does not establish the origin of every individual bearer’s name or a Malay meaning of night. [Sanskrit reference](https://sanskritguru.srihayavadhana.com/dictionary/nisha/)

etymology.historical_story: Malay nod corresponds to English node, whose Latin source nodus means knot. The image of a knot provides a useful bridge to connected points in diagrams and networks. The same international term also appears in wave physics, where a node has zero displacement. These technical meanings share a name but require different definitions. [Paris Observatory dictionary](https://dictionary.obspm.fr/terms/node/).

etymology.historical_story: English nanny belongs to a cluster of familiar nursery expressions associated with caregiving. Its origin is commonly connected with children's speech, while an association with the personal name Ann has also been proposed. These explanations concern English history; they do not establish when the word entered Malaysian conversation or whether it has become a standard Malay borrowing. [Etymonline: nanny](https://www.etymonline.com/word/nanny)

etymology.historical_story: English nobby is formed from nob, referring to a person of wealth or social standing, and the adjective suffix -y. Its meanings connect fashionable appearance with social prestige, and also extend to excellence. This English derivation explains the foreign word; it provides no evidence that nobby has become an established Malay borrowing. [Collins dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/nobby)

etymology.historical_story: Narnia was already a place-name before it became a literary kingdom: it is the Latin name of Narni, an Italian town. An account reported by the Italian heritage organization FAI connects Lewis's choice to an atlas he owned. The appealing name thus travelled from classical geography into a fantasy setting familiar to generations of readers. [FAI](https://fondoambiente.it/news/le-cronache-di-narnia-narni)

etymology.historical_story: The story of nantikan is visible in Malay word formation: nanti combines with -kan to direct waiting towards a person, event or arrival. The fuller active form is menantikan. Public announcements use the short imperative Nantikan! to turn an ordinary act of waiting into an invitation to anticipate the next announcement or release. [DBP lexical basis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=menantikan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nanti 想到“等会儿”，加 -kan 就把等待指向对象：Nantikan berita itu!——等着看那条消息！

etymology.historical_story: DBP records nangis as conversational Malay and directs readers to tangis. This connection places the everyday spoken form beside standard menangis and the noun tangisan. The useful cultural story is the relationship between conversation and edited writing: the same act of crying receives different wording according to register. The entry does not establish a separate historical borrowing. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=nangis)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tangis、menangis、nangis 连成一串：哭声 → 哭泣 → 聊天里说“哭”。

etymology.historical_story: Napoleon is a personal name, not a Malay compound. Its best-known bearer was born in Ajaccio, Corsica, in 1769 and became Emperor of the French in 1804. The deeper origin of his given name remains debated. For learners, its historical association explains recognition more securely than any invented breakdown into meaningful Malay syllables. [Fondation Napoléon](https://www.napoleon.org/histoire-des-2-empires/chronologies/vie-et-regne-de-napoleon)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Napoleon 直接对应中文“拿破仑”，联想历史画像中的双角帽；整个人名一起记，不拆词根。

etymology.historical_story: Natasha began as a Russian affectionate form of Natalya. Literary readers may recognize the name from Natasha Rostova in Tolstoy's War and Peace. senses.zh_definition: 牛顿，国际单位制中力的导出单位，符号为 N；1 牛顿等于使质量为 1 千克的物体产生每二次方秒 1 米加速度所需的合力。
senses.en_definition: The SI derived unit of force, symbol N, equal to one kilogram metre per second squared.
senses.ms_definition: Unit terbitan SI bagi daya, bersimbol N; satu newton ialah daya paduan yang menghasilkan pecutan satu meter per saat kuasa dua pada jasad berjisim satu kilogram.
senses.nuances: 1 N = 1 kg·m·s⁻²。单位名称 newton 通常小写，单位符号 N 必须大写；人名 Newton 则大写。牛顿衡量力，千克衡量质量。此处马来语释义根据 SI 定义编写，并非冒充 DBP 原文。定义依据：[NPL：力的国际单位](https://www.npl.co.uk/resources/q-a/what-is-the-si-unit-of-force)。

etymology.historical_story: The unit takes its name from Isaac Newton, whose work on motion underpins classical mechanics. Malay uses the international name as an ordinary unit noun. The connection becomes concrete through F = ma: one newton corresponds to the net force needed to accelerate one kilogram by one metre per second squared. [CENAM: Force](https://www.cenam.gob.mx/FYP/Fuerza/Introduccion.aspx).

etymology.historical_story: Nite is a simplified English spelling of night, rather than a Malay word formed from local roots. Its shorter appearance suits informal writing, advertisements and playful event names. English dictionaries explicitly mark it as nonstandard. When it appears inside a Malay message, the relevant interpretation is an English insertion; its pronunciation remains that of night. [Cambridge: nite](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/nite)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nite = night 的轻松写法：看到 good nite，就想到 selamat malam——晚安。

etymology.historical_story: Navigasi belongs to an international word family ultimately connected with Latin navigare, meaning to sail, and navis, meaning ship. Its maritime ancestry offers a useful image: finding a course across uncertain waters. Modern usage extends this idea to road guidance and digital interfaces. This historical relationship does not establish the immediate borrowing route into Malaysian Malay. [Etymological reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/navigation)

etymology.historical_story: Nyawaku is transparently formed from nyawa and the shortened pronoun aku. Malay dictionaries connect nyawa both with the life that animates a body and with a dearly loved person. This semantic bridge explains its emotional force: calling someone nyawaku presents that person as precious as life itself, especially in intimate or literary expression.

etymology.historical_story: English borrowed nullah from Hindi and Urdu nālā; Merriam-Webster records English use from 1776. The word names gullies and ravines in South Asian settings. In Hong Kong engineering usage, it also names drainage channels carrying stormwater, showing how a regional landscape term acquired a specialised urban infrastructure meaning. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/nullah), [Hong Kong Development Bureau](https://www.devb.gov.hk/en/sdev/press/index_id_3870.html)

etymology.historical_story: Nenek is a Malay kinship term whose dictionary meanings extend from a grandmother to an elderly woman. Neneknya adds the attached pronoun -nya to identify whose grandmother is meant. The form illustrates a useful cultural and grammatical distinction: a kinship word can become a respectful address, while possession remains a separate grammatical relationship.

etymology.historical_story: Nim belongs to the naming tradition surrounding the neem tree, also called semambu in Malay. English neem derives from Hindi and Urdu nīm, ultimately Sanskrit nimba, although the precise borrowing route into Malay remains unverified. Research on Malay medical manuscripts connects this tree with a longstanding herbal tradition, showing how one species can carry several names across neighbouring communities. Etymological reference: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/neem).

etymology.historical_story: Ngapain belongs to colloquial Indonesian associated with Jakarta. Linguistic analyses connect apa, meaning “what,” with a nasal verbal prefix and the suffix -in. The resulting question can ask about an activity or challenge its purpose. Its spread beyond Jakarta illustrates how a conversational form can travel between communities without becoming a standard Malaysian Malay expression.

etymology.historical_story: English nerd has an uncertain origin. A creature bearing that name appears in Dr. Seuss’s 1950 book If I Ran the Zoo, but its connection with the later slang is not securely established. The label subsequently developed an additional, sometimes affectionate meaning for people deeply absorbed in specialist interests. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordplay/word-history-nerd)

etymology.historical_story: Nyx comes from the Greek name for Night, personified as a primordial goddess in ancient mythology. Classical accounts treat night as a divine presence rather than merely an absence of daylight. The cosmetics brand NYX later adopted that mythological name, so a modern occurrence may refer either to cultural history or to a commercial brand. [Theoi](https://www.theoi.com/Protogenos/Nyx.html), [L’Oréal](https://www.loreal-finance.com/sites/default/files/minisites/2016/en/annual-report-2016/brands-overview.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Nyx /nɪks/：用共同的开头 n 联想 night，再想象夜幕中的女神；彩妆品牌沿用了这个名字。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的后附代词形式，在这里表示“我的”，并非派生新词的后缀；依给定分类记为 suffix。两个 e 均读 /e/，不是 /ə/；k + k 在拼写中都保留，所列读法中词基末 k 实现为 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 我的祖母或外祖母，即我父亲或母亲的母亲。

senses.ms_definition: Ibu kepada bapa atau ibu saya; nenek yang mempunyai hubungan kekeluargaan dengan saya.
senses.nuances: nenek 不区分父系和母系，翻译成中文时须根据语境选择“奶奶”或“外婆”。-ku 已包含“我的”，不是词根的一部分。nenekku 常带亲密或叙事色彩；nenek saya 是较中性的表达。这里的释义由 nenek 与 -ku 组合得出，不冒称 DBP 为完整词形另立了词条。参见 [DBP：nenek](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=nenek)及 [DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ku)。

etymology.historical_story: Nenekku combines the kinship word nenek with -ku, the attached form of aku. Malay can therefore express an entire relationship, 'my grandmother', in one written word. The construction illustrates how a pronoun becomes closely bound to the preceding noun. It does not distinguish the paternal and maternal sides, a distinction Chinese translations often need to make explicit. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ku)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nenek＝奶奶／外婆，-ku＝我的；把 -ku 紧贴在后面，就是 nenekku＝我的奶奶／外婆。

senses.nuances: DBP 标为 bk，即 bahasa kasar。它不是中性的“离开”，也不宜直接当成及物动词“移除某物”；后者通常使用 mengenyahkan。释义据 DBP 改写。[DBP：nyah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=nyah)

senses.zh_definition: 用作构词前缀 nyah-，表示去除、消除或解除某种成分、状态或作用。
senses.en_definition: As the bound prefix nyah-, indicating removal, elimination, or reversal of a condition or effect.
senses.ms_definition: Sebagai awalan nyah-, membawa maksud membuang, menghapuskan atau meniadakan sesuatu unsur atau keadaan.
senses.nuances: 这是黏着前缀义，不是独立虚词；此处 particle 仅为所给词类选项中的近似标记。技术用语中的 nyah- 不带“滚开”的粗鲁语气，也不能机械替换所有英语 de-、dis- 或 un-。[DBP：nyah- 的用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=nyah)

etymology.historical_story: Nyah offers a striking contrast between everyday speech and technical language. As an independent word, dictionaries label it a coarse command to leave. As nyah-, it appears in neutral terminology such as nyahcas and nyahwarna. DBP explains this prefix as a Malay equivalent of English de- or dis-. Its deeper historical origin is not established here. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=nyah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把短促的 nyah 想成“把人喝走”的一声；看到 nyah- 接在技术词前，则转成“把某种东西去掉”。

etymology.historical_story: Nathaniel is an English variant of Nathanael, from a Hebrew name meaning 'God has given.' Its historical components relate to giving and God, but they are not Malay morphemes. The name travelled through biblical naming traditions into English and can occur unchanged in Malaysian multilingual settings. See [Behind the Name: Nathanael](https://www.behindthename.com/name/nathanael).

morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 nafi，接 -kan 时不删音。nafikan 可用于祈使句及第一、第二人称被动结构，口语中也可省略 menafikan 的 meN-。输入包将 nafikan 标为独立词根，此处据其透明构词关系纠正。

etymology.historical_story: The base nafi is identified by DBP as an Arabic loan associated with denial or negation. Malay combines it with its own suffix -kan to form nafikan, and with the active prefix to form menafikan. The resulting family connects everyday denials with more abstract expressions such as kata nafi, the grammatical term for a negating word.

etymology.historical_story: Nek developed as a shortened form of nenek, the everyday Malay word for a grandmother. DBP explicitly records this relationship. The shortened form suits direct address and familiar conversation, where a brief kinship term can carry warmth and respect. It can also accompany an elderly woman's name, extending family-style address beyond biological relatives. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=nek)

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，用于语码混用；不按马来语构词分析。英语读法为一个音节，词尾 e 不单独发音，也不是马来语后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 不；没有；不是。英语非正式否定答语，在夹杂英语的马来语聊天中用于回应问题或拒绝提议。
senses.en_definition: An informal English negative response meaning no, also used in mixed-language conversation.
senses.ms_definition: Jawapan penafian tidak formal daripada bahasa Inggeris, sepadan dengan tidak, bukan atau bentuk penafian lain mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: 不是正式马来语否定词。此处 particle 表示其独立答语功能；Cambridge 将其列为英语 interjection。它不能在标准马来语句法中随意替代所有 tidak 或 bukan。以下搭配为聊天示例，不代表已测定的高频搭配。出处：[Cambridge 英马词典：nope](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-malaysian/nope)。

etymology.historical_story: Nope comes into mixed Malay conversation as an English expression, not through a Malay affix. English dictionaries record its informal negative meaning. A Malaysian study of online language also lists nope among expressions found in netspeak, illustrating how chat vocabulary crosses language boundaries while retaining a distinctly casual conversational function. etymology.historical_story: Naiki combines naik with the suffix -i. Its dictionary meanings connect climbing, boarding vehicles, entering houses by steps, and beginning life in a new home. Together, these meanings offer a cultural picture of upward movement becoming entry or occupancy. The expression menaiki takhta extends that same upward image to becoming a ruler.

etymology.historical_story: In computing, Norton carries a person's surname into a product name. Peter Norton became known as a programmer, businessman, and technical author, and sold his software business to Symantec in 1990. This provides the historical background to the familiar software name, while leaving other people and places called Norton entirely separate. See [Caltech's biography](https://board.caltech.edu/board-members/mr-peter-norton).

etymology.historical_story: The colour use of navy recalls the dark blue associated with naval uniforms. Royal Navy uniform collections preserve examples from the eighteenth century, making that connection tangible. In Malaysian shopping conversations, the English colour label can appear inside Malay sentences, while a formal Malay description can simply identify the shade as biru tua. [Royal Museums Greenwich](https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/objects/rmgc-object-71217).

etymology.historical_story: Nigeria takes its name from the Niger River. British journalist Flora Shaw proposed the name in an article published in 1897, linking a geographical feature to a political designation. Malay uses Nigeria as a complete country name; its history should not be confused with productive Malay word formation. [Historical reference](https://library.au.int/niger-and-classics-history-name-2)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论逝者时语气宜平和、尊重；与家属交谈可先说 batu nisan arwah，再按关系补充姓名或称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于墓地、家族纪念与历史研究。进入墓地、拍摄墓碑或安排清理修复时，先遵循家属及管理方的安排；地区饮食语境中的 nisan 则应明确所指糖类。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈论逝者时语气宜平和、尊重；与家属交谈可先说 batu nisan arwah，再按关系补充姓名或称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于墓地、家族纪念与历史研究。进入墓地、拍摄墓碑或安排清理修复时，先遵循家属及管理方的安排；地区饮食语境中的 nisan 则应明确所指糖类。

etymology.historical_story: Scholarly discussion of Persian vocabulary in Malay connects nisan with Persian nishan, meaning a sign or mark. The Malay grave-marker meaning makes that connection memorable: a stone marks a person's resting place and preserves identifying information. The regional palm-sugar meaning belongs to a separate usage and should not be explained through the same grave-marker story. See [UKM's discussion](https://www.ukm.my/jatma/wp-content/uploads/makalah/SARI/SARI-1986-0401-06.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ni.san 的两个音节想成墓碑上的两行字：第一行姓名，第二行日期；看到 nisan，就想到标明墓位的石碑。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留数据包中的直接基干 namakan；基础词根是 nama。-nya 是第三人称附着代词，此处充当宾语，不是普通派生后缀。连接时基干不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。无 meN- 的形式可用于祈使句、特定被动结构及口语。

senses.zh_definition: 给他、她或它命名；称其为某个名称。
senses.en_definition: To give him, her, or it a name; to call the referent by a specified name.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan nama atau gelaran kepada orang atau sesuatu yang dirujuk oleh -nya.
senses.nuances: -nya 的所指须从上下文确定，不标性别。独立祈使句中可译为“给它取名……”。完整主动陈述句通常使用 menamakannya。释义依据 [DBP：nama](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=nama) 中 menamakan 的命名义改写。

senses.nuances: 通常接 sebagai calon、sebagai wakil 等补语；提名本身不表示已经当选或获任命。完整主动陈述句通常使用 menamakannya。依据 [DBP：nama](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=nama) 的提名义改写；所列搭配为常用句法框架，未经独立语料频率排序。

collocations.en: nominate him or her as a candidate
nominate him or her as a representative

etymology.historical_story: Malay connects naming with public recognition: menamakan can mean giving something a name or putting someone forward as a candidate. Namakannya adds a third-person object to namakan, allowing a speaker to refer back to an already mentioned person or thing. Its interpretation therefore depends on the surrounding sentence. [DBP: nama](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=nama)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nama＝名字；-kan＝实施命名；-nya＝他、她或它：把名字给它，也就是“给它取名”。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借用；在马来语中不作词缀拆分。英语内部为 note + book 的复合词。IPA 采用英语标准读音；输入包未提供音节划分及爪夷文，保留 null。没有据此确认的常用马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 笔记本；供手写记录、记事或做笔记的本子。
senses.en_definition: A book of blank or ruled pages used for writing notes.
senses.ms_definition: Buku yang digunakan untuk menulis nota atau catatan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词在马来语交谈中的借用义。规范马来语可用 buku nota 或 buku catatan；此处马来语定义为释义性改写，并非 DBP 将 notebook 列为规范马来语词头的证明。[DBP 英马词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=notebook)

senses.zh_definition: 笔记本电脑；便于携带、通常将屏幕与键盘合为一体的电脑。
senses.en_definition: A portable computer with an integrated screen and keyboard; a laptop.
senses.ms_definition: Komputer mudah alih yang menggabungkan skrin dan papan kekunci dalam satu unit.
senses.nuances: 电脑销售、设备清单及职场交流中可见此用法；规范表述通常用 komputer riba，DBP 也将 notebook computer 对应为 komputer buku。应结合台、部等量词及充电、键盘等语境，与纸质笔记本区分。[DBP 电脑术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=notebook)

etymology.historical_story: English notebook combines note and book, naming a book for written records. The same word also names a portable computer, linking a familiar writing object with a compact electronic device. Malaysian users may therefore encounter it in both stationery and computer settings, while Malay distinguishes the meanings with buku nota and komputer riba. [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/notebook)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记英语 note（笔记）＋ book（本子）：纸上写的是笔记本，接电开机的是笔记本电脑；马来语分别说 buku nota、komputer riba。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语整词借入，现代马来语中作为独立词根记忆。派生时，ber- 构成 bernikah；meN- 遇词首 n，形成 menikahkan，保留词根的 n。

word_family.gloss: 使结为夫妻；为双方主持婚约

senses.zh_definition: 婚约；通过要约与承诺的宣告缔结、使男女双方成为合法夫妻的婚姻契约，在马来西亚通常用于伊斯兰婚姻语境。
senses.en_definition: A marriage contract establishing a lawful marital union, especially in Islamic usage; marriage.
senses.ms_definition: Akad atau perjanjian yang mengandungi lafaz ijab dan kabul yang menghalalkan pasangan lelaki dan perempuan melakukan persetubuhan; perkahwinan.
senses.nuances: 核心指缔结婚姻的契约及婚姻关系。Akad nikah 强调缔结婚约，majlis persandingan 强调婚宴中的新人并坐仪式，两者可以分别举行。义项依据 [DBP PRPM：nikah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=nikah)。

collocations.zh: 缔结婚约的仪式；婚姻契约

senses.zh_definition: 结婚；在口语中以无前缀形式表示缔结婚姻。
senses.en_definition: To marry or get married, used informally without a verbal prefix.
senses.ms_definition: Berkahwin atau bernikah; digunakan tanpa awalan dalam percakapan tidak rasmi.
senses.nuances: 这是口语中的动词用法。正式叙述通常使用 bernikah 或 berkahwin；表达与某人结婚可说 bernikah dengan seseorang。

collocations.en: want to get married; be planning to marry

etymology.historical_story: Nikah entered Malay from Arabic nikāḥ, a word for marriage and the marriage contract. Its continuing use reflects the importance of Islamic marriage practices in Malay society. The familiar expression akad nikah centres attention on the contract itself, helping learners distinguish the solemnisation from the reception and other wedding celebrations.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ni.kah 与 akad nikah 连着记：想到双方正式缔结婚约，就想到 nikah。不要把音节拆成虚构词根。

etymology.historical_story: Next belongs to English, where it marks the immediately following item or stage. Its adjective and adverb uses explain the examples here: next week points to a following period, while next can introduce another step. In Malay conversation, the English form can be inserted into a Malay sentence; standard equivalents include berikutnya and seterusnya. [English source](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/next)

etymology.historical_story: NYPD is an English institutional initialism rather than an inherited Malay word. Its letters represent New York Police Department, identifying the New York City Police Department. The department's historical timeline records a police chief appointment in 1845 and its reestablishment in 1870. Malay writing retains the institution's Latin-letter abbreviation. [NYPD history](https://www.nyc.gov/site/nypd/about/history/history-timeline.page)

etymology.historical_story: Namaste comes from Sanskrit namaḥ, meaning a bow or respectful salutation, and te, meaning to you. The expression therefore conveys a salutation directed to another person. Its association with joined palms makes respect visible as well as audible. Interpretations about honouring another person's inner divinity are spiritual elaborations rather than the expression's literal grammatical translation. [Merriam-Webster dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/namaste).

etymology.historical_story: Napas is the Indonesian counterpart of Malaysian nafas, a borrowing from Arabic nafas, meaning breath. An etymological study identifies nafas in the Malay Hikayat Amir Hamzah tradition, showing its established literary history. The modern p and f forms illustrate different regional outcomes of borrowed vocabulary, rather than different meanings. See [Jurnal Linguistik](https://plm.org.my/ejurnal/index.php/jurnallinguistik/article/download/249/179/).

etymology.historical_story: Nolan is an English form of the Irish surname Ó Nualláin, traditionally understood as 'descendant of Nuallán'. It belongs to the history of personal naming, rather than Malay word formation. In Malay film discussion, the surname may identify Christopher Nolan when the context is clear, but that contextual reference does not create a separate Malay common noun. See [Irish Names and Surnames](https://www.libraryireland.com/names/on/o-nuallain.php).

etymology.historical_story: Nantinya combines nanti, associated with a later time, and -nya, which here helps frame that future time rather than identify an owner. This connects with the familiar waiting vocabulary menanti and penantian. DBP records nantinya inside a dictionary example, showing its use in prose without establishing a separate historical borrowing story. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=nantinya)

etymology.historical_story: Nonton belongs to a regional family centred on tonton, meaning to watch. Indonesian government dictionaries record related forms in Javanese and Betawi, showing that it is more than an accidental misspelling. For Malaysian learners, the useful connection is between regional nonton and standard menonton: both concern watching, but their appropriate settings differ. See the [official etymological dictionary](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/23879/1/KAMUS%20ETIMOLOGI%20BAHASA%20INDONESIA.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: non-ton 两拍，想象两眼盯着屏幕；正式表达补回 me-，记成 menonton。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语地名 Tamil Nadu 中按外来专名成分整体处理；没有马来语词缀可拆。此分析不证明小写 nadu 是独立马来语普通词，也不确定其统一马来语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 外来地名组成部分，见印度南部邦名 Tamil Nadu（泰米尔纳德邦）；不据此认定 nadu 是独立的标准马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: A component of Tamil Nadu, the name of a state in southern India; not established here as an independent Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama khas dalam Tamil Nadu, nama sebuah negeri di selatan India; penggunaan nadu sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 以上为专名用途的编辑释义，并非 DBP 词典定义。实际指称该邦时保留完整名称 Tamil Nadu，不能任意缩成 Nadu。DBP 的马来语报道使用该完整地名：[《Dewan Masyarakat》报道](https://dewanmasyarakat.jendeladbp.my/2025/11/28/33739/)。以下为地名及其句法组合，不是 nadu 的独立词义搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Tamil Nadu also appears in Malaysian cultural reporting, not just on maps of India. A DBP report on the 2025 Selangor International Book Fair names Tamil Nadu among its overseas guests, alongside Guangdong. This illustrates how a foreign place name enters Malay discourse intact through cultural exchange; the isolated token alone does not establish a Malay lexical borrowing. [Dewan Masyarakat](https://dewanmasyarakat.jendeladbp.my/2025/11/28/33739/)

morphology.pattern_note: ny 表示单一辅音 /ɲ/；词根末尾 a 与后缀 -an 的 a 相邻，通常分属两个音节，部分读法之间有喉塞音。资料包未提供分音，故保留 null；按构词可分为 nya.la.an。资料包的 ڽالا 是词根 nyala 的爪夷文，头词字段依要求原样保留。

etymology.historical_story: Nyalaan has a transparent Malay formation: nyala plus the noun-forming suffix -an. Its word family connects the visible flame with menyala, being alight, and menyalakan, causing something to burn or light up. This account concerns observable word formation; the supplied evidence does not establish a deeper historical origin for nyala. See [DBP: nyala](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=nyala).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: nyala 是“火在燃”，加 -an 后把眼前那团火焰当作一个事物来记：nyala + an → nyalaan。

word_family.gloss: 已联网的；已连接成网络的

senses.zh_definition: 由彼此连接的设备、线路、地点或机构组成的网络或系统。
senses.en_definition: A system of interconnected devices, routes, locations or organizations.
senses.ms_definition: Rangkaian peranti, laluan, tempat atau organisasi yang saling berhubung.
senses.nuances: DBP 英马词典将英语 network 对译为 rangkaian。计算机、通信、道路与广播等语境均须结合具体对象理解；口语 network tak ada 有时指没有通信信号或连接，但并不精确区分故障原因。[DBP：network](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=network)

senses.zh_definition: 能够相互交流信息、提供支持或开展合作的人际关系网。
senses.en_definition: A group of personal or professional contacts who exchange information, support or opportunities.
senses.ms_definition: Jaringan hubungan peribadi atau profesional untuk bertukar maklumat, memberikan sokongan atau bekerjasama.
senses.nuances: 规范马来语可用 jaringan hubungan、jaringan profesional 或 rangkaian kenalan。这里强调联系与合作，不自动含有靠关系谋取不当利益的意思。[Collins：network](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/network)

senses.zh_definition: 主动结识并维系职业或商业联系人，以交流信息和寻找合作机会。
senses.en_definition: To establish and maintain professional contacts for exchanging information or finding opportunities.
senses.ms_definition: Membina dan mengekalkan hubungan profesional untuk bertukar maklumat atau mendapatkan peluang kerjasama.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词义；马来语口语中也常借用 networking 表示相关活动。正式表达宜用 membina jaringan profesional。英语 network 另可表示把设备连接成网络，不能将所有动词用法都理解为交际。[Collins：network](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/network)

etymology.historical_story: English network combines net and work, preserving the image of an interconnected structure. Its meanings encompass physical systems and groups of people, making the same image useful in transport, communications and professional life. Malay expresses the central connection through rangkaian; DBP explicitly uses this equivalent when explaining how foreign terminology can be translated. [Collins word history](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/network), [DBP terminology guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: net 是“网”，work 联想“运作”：设备连接起来运作是网络，人连接起来合作是人脉。马来语核心对应词记 rangkaian。

etymology.historical_story: Ngan is a shortened conversational form of dengan. Losing the opening syllable leaves the final nasal sound at the beginning of the word. Its appearance in informal writing reflects spoken pronunciation rather than a new grammatical function. No precise invention date is established here; the useful connection is between the everyday shortened form and its standard written counterpart.

morphology.pattern_note: -kah 是附着式疑问小品词，此处按字段归为后缀；直接接在 nampak 后，保留两个 k。音节与音标按完整词形补全；所给 Jawi 原样保留，但实际只对应词根 nampak，未包含 -kah。[DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Nampakkah illustrates how Malay turns an ordinary predicate into a focused question. Its lexical meaning comes from nampak, while the attached particle -kah supplies the interrogative function. Malay spelling joins the particle to the preceding word. Everyday Malaysian conversation commonly expresses the corresponding question with nampak tak, giving learners a useful connection between written grammar and spoken interaction.

etymology.historical_story: NU takes its initials from Nahdlatul Ulama, an Arabic-derived name meaning the awakening of religious scholars. Founded in Surabaya in 1926, the organization later became a political party in 1952. Its return to its founding social and religious orientation in 1984 explains why an older dictionary's political label needs historical context. [ANRI history](https://pemanfaatan.anri.go.id/pameran/detail/nahdlatul-ulama-dari-masa-ke-masa).

etymology.historical_story: Nandini belongs to a Sanskrit naming tradition: nandinī can mean “daughter” and is associated with rejoicing. Sanskrit literature also uses Nandini as the name of a sacred cow connected with the sage Vasiṣṭha. These older associations explain the name’s cultural background; they do not make it the ordinary Malay word for a daughter. [Sanskrit dictionary evidence](https://sanskritdictionary.in/shabdkosh?search=नन्दिनी).

etymology.historical_story: English nos. is the plural written abbreviation of number. In Malaysian administrative practice, the form also appears as a counting unit in bills of quantities. An official audit report contrasts nos with metres, illustrating why this small abbreviation matters: counting individual doors and measuring their length are different operations with different payment consequences. [English abbreviation](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/nos); [Malaysian audit example](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/ipms/eps/2023-10-10/CMD.49.2023%20-%20CMD49.2023.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Nuh is the Malay form of the Arabic prophetic name Nūḥ, corresponding to Noah in English. In Malay Muslim storytelling, the name commonly appears with the title Nabi and evokes the ark, perseverance and faith. DBP's theatrical coverage shows how this inherited religious narrative also continues through contemporary Malaysian performance. [DBP theatre report](https://tunascipta.jendeladbp.my/2025/01/22/10381/)

etymology.historical_story: Nightshade continues Old English nihtscada, a compound corresponding to night and shade. Related plant names occur in other Germanic languages, including German Nachtschatten. The reason for the original naming is uncertain; an association with dark berries is only a proposed explanation. The word therefore preserves an old naming tradition rather than a precise modern botanical classification. Source: [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/nightshade).

senses.zh_definition: 意志坚定的；决心已定、坚持要实现某个目标的。

senses.zh_definition: 不顾后果的；因绝望、压力或强烈意愿而不再考虑风险的。
senses.en_definition: Reckless or desperate, acting without regard for the consequences.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak lagi mempertimbangkan risiko atau akibat ketika hendak melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 比一般的 berani 更强调不计后果；可暗示走投无路，但不必然表示绝望。

senses.zh_definition: 执拗的；坚持己见、不肯认输或让步的。
senses.en_definition: Obstinate and unwilling to concede or give way.
senses.ms_definition: Berkeras dengan pendirian sendiri dan enggan mengalah.
senses.nuances: 与积极的坚定意志相邻，但此义强调拒绝让步，通常带批评意味。

etymology.historical_story: The deeper origin of nekad is not established by the supplied evidence. Its semantic range nevertheless tells a revealing cultural story: Malay can describe perseverance, fearlessness, recklessness, and stubbornness with the same word. What changes is the speaker's judgment of the purpose, danger, and consequences surrounding someone's refusal to turn back.

etymology.historical_story: Nasib is an Arabic loanword, from naṣīb, meaning a share or allotted portion. Malay uses it for fate or fortune, making a person's circumstances conceptually their allotted share. Nasibnya adds the Malay enclitic -nya to identify whose fate is meant. An early bilingual vocabulary explicitly records nasib as Arabic in origin. [Historical Malay vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b9/Vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages_%28IA_afu7962.0002.001.umich.edu%29.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: This entry illustrates the boundary between an English word and a standard Malay equivalent. etymology.historical_story: Nicolas is the French form of Nicholas, ultimately associated with Greek Nikolaos and the elements nike, victory, and laos, people. Related names spread across languages, producing forms such as Nicholas and Nicole. In a Malay sentence, however, Nicolas identifies a person; its ancient components do not function as Malay vocabulary or affixes. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/nicolas)

etymology.historical_story: English newt preserves a striking change in word boundaries. An older animal name, ewt, occurred after the article an. Speakers reinterpreted an ewt as a newt, transferring the article's final n to the noun. The older name ultimately continues Old English efeta. This English history supplies no evidence that newt is an established Malay loanword. [Oxford Learner’s Dictionary](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/newt)

etymology.historical_story: Natalia belongs to a European naming tradition connected with Latin natalis, referring to birth or a birthday. Christian usage associated this naming family with Christmas, the celebration of Christ's birth. Its spread across languages produced different pronunciations and related forms. In Malay discourse, Natalia functions as a person's name rather than a word meaning Christmas. [Reference](https://nameberry.com/name/natalia)

etymology.historical_story: English norm ultimately comes from Latin norma, a carpenter's square and, figuratively, a rule or pattern. The history connects a physical tool for checking angles with an abstract standard for judging conduct or performance. DBP gives norma as the Malay equivalent of English norm; the similar spellings do not establish a Malay suffix -a. [Collins：norm](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/norm)，[DBP：norma](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=norma)

etymology.historical_story: Nikolai belongs to the international family of names descended from Greek Nikolaos, combining elements associated with victory and people. Russian Николай is commonly rendered Nikolai or Nikolay in the Roman alphabet. Its appearance in Malay writing generally reflects the naming of people, rather than the adoption of a new Malay common noun. [Sources: name study](https://ans-names.pitt.edu/ans/article/download/1729/1728/3460), [Oxford LGPN](https://lgpn.web.ox.ac.uk/greek-names-english).

senses.ms_definition: Sejenis roti leper daripada tepung gandum yang secara tradisional dibakar di dalam tandur; juga disebut roti nan atau roti naan.

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Dewan entry marks nan as Minangkabau and records both a yang-like function and use in completing poetic lines. Its literary character therefore reflects regional language and verse practice. Food-related nan belongs to a separate lexical item, also written naan. Shared spelling should not turn these different histories into a single invented origin story.

etymology.historical_story: Nafkah comes from Arabic nafaqah, associated with expenditure and maintenance. Its cultural significance extends beyond earning money: family discussions use it for the resources that keep dependants fed, clothed and housed. In Malay, the familiar expression mencari nafkah also makes the word part of everyday working life, linking a household responsibility with the broader experience of making a living. [UII: Fikih Nafkah](https://fis.uii.ac.id/blog/2021/12/27/fikih-nafkah/).

senses.zh_definition: 氮，元素符号 N、原子序数为 7 的非金属元素；常温下其单质主要以无色无臭的双原子气体 N₂ 存在，约占空气体积的 78%。
senses.en_definition: The nonmetallic element N, atomic number 7, occurring naturally as a colourless, odourless diatomic gas that makes up about 78% of air by volume.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur gas yang tidak berbau dan tidak berwarna, wujud secara semula jadi dalam atmosfera sebanyak kira-kira 78%, serta digunakan dalam pembuatan ammonia, asid nitrik dan bahan kimia lain.
senses.nuances: 可指氮元素，也可依语境指氮气；nitrogen cecair 指液氮。肥料中的 kandungan nitrogen 指氮含量，不表示肥料内装有氮气。nitrogen dioksida 是另一种化合物，不能把其棕色和刺激性气味当作氮气的性质。[DBP 词义与科学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=nitrogen)

etymology.historical_story: The international name nitrogen means roughly 'nitre former', recalling the element's connection with saltpetre and nitrates. Earlier chemists also used azote, a name referring to its inability to sustain life by itself. Malay uses nitrogen in scientific vocabulary, linking an invisible component of ordinary air with the chemistry behind ammonia, fertilisers and modern industrial production. [Royal Society of Chemistry](https://periodic-table.rsc.org/element/7/nitrogen/)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect ngauman with aum, the sound of a tiger or lion, and also record the base ngaum. This creates a useful learning link between an animal's call and the noun naming that call. It supports a sound-based mnemonic, but does not establish a dated origin or prove a particular historical sound change. [Sources: ngaum](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=ngaum), [aum](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=aum)

etymology.historical_story: Nilah illustrates everyday shortening within Malay rather than borrowing from another language. Speakers shorten ini to ni and attach the emphatic particle -lah, producing the conversational counterpart of inilah. DBP advice explicitly recognizes the joined spelling nilah in informal usage while recommending the full form inilah for more grammatical, formal expression. No separate ancient root is needed. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tulah+tu+lah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ini 丢掉开头的 i，再加 lah：ni + lah → nilah。想象手指一点：“就是这个啦！”

etymology.historical_story: The English name Norway is traditionally associated with a northern sea route along the Scandinavian coast. This geographical image recalls a time when coastal navigation connected scattered settlements more effectively than overland travel. Malay uses Norway as an international country name; its historical components are not productive Malay morphemes. See [The Kingdom of Norway](https://journals.hil.unb.ca/index.php/ihr/article/download/23006/26703/35084).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Norway 联想到 north + way：沿着向北的航路，记住北欧的挪威；这是词源联想，不是马来语构词拆分。

messages.ms_spoken: Kalau maksudnya arah, ya. Tapi tengok konteks dulu, mana tahu nama tempat je.

etymology.historical_story: Norwest is recorded as an English variant of nor'-west, associated with northwest. Similar spellings also appear in historical European records, but that does not establish a Malay borrowing. Without the original sentence, this packet cannot distinguish a foreign directional expression from a proper name or an unsuitable corpus item. Its Malay lexical status therefore remains unverified. [English entry](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/norwest)；[Anglo-Norman Dictionary](https://www.anglo-norman.net/entry/norwest)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 仅在英语方向义中，把 nor 联想到 north、west 联想到西：合起来就是西北；马来语对应 barat laut。
